name: Home appliance repair
summary: How expats get fridge, washer, dryer, and oven repairs in Singapore — warranty vs third-party techs, condo access rules, and when replacement beats repair.
body:
Humid heat and hard water shorten appliance life. Brand warranty centres handle in-warranty jobs; third-party techs often win on out-of-warranty speed and price. Condos add lift booking and quiet-hour constraints.

## Typical jobs
- Fridge not cooling / iced evaporator
- Washer error codes and drum bearing noise
- Dryer no-heat and lint-related faults
- Oven / hob ignition failures
- Dishwasher drain and detergent issues

Keep model plates photographed — techs quote faster with exact SKUs.

## How to choose
Ask for diagnostic fees upfront and whether they offset repair cost. Prefer techs who stock common parts for your brand. Confirm same-day vs next-day windows before taking leave.

## Practical tip
Clear the cabinet toe-kick and unplug before the visit. Half of first visits die waiting for access to the power point.
